channel.title: Understanding Cocoa Cultivation :: Commodity Recognition Book
channel.description: Learn how cocoa is grown and why it looks the way it does from above.

item.title: Cocoa Cultivation Systems
item.description: Explore the diverse ways cocoa is planted, from irregular smallholder plots to highly structured commercial plantations.

item.description: Learn how cocoa is grown with shade and companion crops in diverse agroforestry systems.

item.title: Pruning Practices
item.description: Understand how pruning shapes cocoa canopies and influences their appearance in satellite imagery.

item.title: The Cocoa Life Cycle
item.description: Follow the stages of cocoa’s long life cycle, from seedling to full production.

item.title: Cocoa Tree Characteristics
item.description: Learn how cocoa tree structure and foliage influence its appearance in satellite imagery.

item.title: Cocoa Varieties
item.description: Discover how cocoa varieties and propagation methods shape field structure and canopy appearance.
